pcs.pc_description: identify the required raw materials like diamonds and / or gemstones of required cut, shape, quantity and weights etc., specified on the job sheet or skeletal diagram
match the size of diamonds and / or gemstones received against the requirement

modules.module_title: Prepare each wax piece before stone setting

pcs.pc_description: check all wax pieces for signs of defects, which might get reflected in the metal jewellery piece during casting
segregate the defective pieces for rejection or repair in consultation with the supervisor
prepare the wax piece by cleaning the excess wax, making precut in prongs or channels for secure setting of stones

modules.module_title: Setting the diamonds and/ or gemstones in the wax piece

pcs.pc_description: select tools, materials and equipment in accordance with the type of stone setting technique, shape or size of stone to be set etc.

set the stones i.e. diamond or gemstone of different sizes in various styles like prong, channel, bead, flush, bezel, pave, micro-pave, invisible etc., as mentioned in the skeletal diagram, using appropriate tools
use the appropriate soldering or locking technique to secure the diamonds and / or gemstones in the wax pieces
inspect the stone set wax piece for various quality defects like uneven stone level, gap between stones, prong-overlapping etc.
repair the observed defects and finish the piece
organize the work station, machine and tools
ensure timely delivery of stone set wax pieces to enable the commencement of wax tree- making process
set number of stones per day against the target given
update the supervisor on the work completion status at the end of shift
handle diamonds and gemstones with care to avoid their loss during setting
inspect the stone set wax piece thoroughly before sending for quality check
rework as per quality control authorities’ feedback on the defective stone set wax pieces
deliver zero defect stone set wax pieces for the next level of processing
